Version 1.1.0.0 Created by Jake McNeil
Skript Changes

Changes in 1.1.0.0

The first development build on the road to Skript 1.1.

Multiple script imports
Select several existing Skript files in one operation and open every valid script as a separate document.
WriterDuet project import
Import native WriterDuet .wdz checkpoint projects and JSON exports, including projects that contain multiple screenplay documents.
Clean WriterDuet dialogue
Remove hidden formatting markers from character names and recombine consecutive native dialogue fragments into one editable speech.
WriterDuet transitions and acts
Right-align screenplay transitions and import WriterDuet Act records as visible New Act elements that always begin a fresh page.
Whole imported dialogue
Keep long imported dialogue as one selectable and editable paragraph, including Word soft line breaks and dialogue that visually extends past a page.
BBC-format script creation
Align Film, TV, Radio Scene Style and Stage projects with the BBC guides, including A4 screenplay margins, regular parentheticals, right-aligned transitions, radio cue columns, page numbering, and fresh pages for Acts and stage scenes.
Optional Notes in exports
Choose whether Notes elements are included in PDF, Word, Fountain, Final Draft and printed script output. Notes stay private by default.
Storyboard multi-selection and arranging
Select several cards or frame objects, then align, distribute, copy, duplicate, delete or move them together.
Snapping and smart guides
Snap objects to the canvas, grid and other objects while live guide lines show matching edges and centres.
Storyboard Undo and Redo
Undo and redo drawing, object, layer, card deletion, duplication and reordering changes with toolbar buttons or standard keyboard shortcuts.
Frame and card management
Copy, paste, duplicate, delete and drag-reorder storyboard cards without separating their artwork, captions or script links.
Multi-script project foundation
Introduces the project-collection format used to group multiple script documents under one project identity.
Safer batch handling
A damaged or invalid file no longer prevents other valid files in the same selection from opening.
Recovery accessibility
Keeps keyboard focus inside the Recovery Centre when it is opened over the startup recovery prompt.
Development verification
Source and browser regression checks cover desktop, compact-touch, storyboard arranging, deletion and history restoration.
